title: Young Boy with 4th Birthday Cake, 1955 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white 1955 snapshot capturing a four-year-old boy named Gary seated at a table beside his decorated birthday cake with candles lit. Behind him stands a classic mid-century vintage refrigerator with a chrome latch handle, offering a glimpse into American domestic family life during the 1950s post-war era.
